decks.notes: The main concept of this deck is to quickly ramp up mana with cards like Elvish Mystic, Llanowar Elves, and Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx to cast big green creatures and powerful planeswalkers early in the game. The deck focuses on creating a large board presence and overwhelming the opponent with a combination of aggressive creature plays and disruptive spells. The ultimate goal is to create a board state that is difficult to deal with efficiently and quickly close out the game before the opponent can stabilize.

The deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's strategy through counterspells, removal spells, and card draw while also generating win conditions through Shark Typhoon and Torrential Gearhulk. It aims to control the board and the opponent's hand while slowly building up a resource advantage to eventually overwhelm the opponent. The deck includes a mix of instant-speed interaction, permission spells, and powerful card advantage engines to outvalue the opponent and secure a victory through attrition.

This deck focuses on quickly assembling a combo using cards like Indomitable Creativity and Secrets of the Key to cheat out powerful creatures like Worldspine Wurm or Xenagos, God of Revels. The deck also includes cards like Shark Typhoon and Big Score to generate tokens and card advantage. With a mix of counter spells, removal, and land manipulation, the goal of the deck is to overwhelm the opponent with unexpected threats and versatile plays, utilizing creativity and ingenuity to outmaneuver and outpace the opponent in a fast-paced format like Pioneer 1 vs 1.

The deck focuses on controlling the opponent's actions and board state through counterspells, removal spells, and card advantage. It aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy while slowly building up its own resources. The inclusion of Kaheera as a companion adds an additional element of synergy to the deck. The deck also includes various win conditions such as Shark Typhoon and Teferi, Hero of Dominaria. Overall, the deck's strategy revolves around maintaining control of the game and outlasting the opponent until it can secure a victory.

The deck focuses on swarming the board with low-cost creatures, utilizing cards like Thalia's Lieutenant and Luminarch Aspirant to pump them up. With protection spells like Brave the Elements and Dauntless Bodyguard, along with Adeline, Resplendent Cathar providing additional creatures, the strategy is to overwhelm the opponent quickly. Mutavault and Shefet Dunes provide additional ways to pump up the team and close out the game. The deck is aggressive and efficient, aiming to put pressure on the opponent early and maintain board presence throughout the match.

The core strategy of this UW Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan through counter spells and removal while controlling the board with powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria and Elspeth, Sun's Champion. The deck aims to maintain card advantage and board presence by using cards like Supreme Verdict and The Wandering Emperor, while also having the flexibility to adapt to different situations with versatile cards like Portable Hole and Spell Pierce. The deck also includes card draw and filtering options to ensure consistency in play.

The main focus of this Selesnya Aggro deck is to quickly deploy powerful and efficient creatures onto the battlefield to pressure the opponent. Cards like Resplendent Angel, Righteous Valkyrie, and Bishop of Wings provide a strong and synergistic creature base, while cards like Collected Company and Skyclave Apparition offer additional value and versatility. The deck also utilizes land cards like Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx and Temple Garden to fuel its aggressive strategy and ensure consistent mana production. This deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a fast and resilient creature-based offense.

The deck focuses on aggressive plays by utilizing sacrificing creatures for value and dealing direct damage to the opponent. The key strategy involves sacrificing Cauldron Familiar with Witch's Oven and Mayhem Devil on the field to deal incremental damage while controlling the board with removal spells like Fatal Push. Claim the Firstborn allows for stealing opponent's creatures, while Fable of the Mirror-Breaker provides card advantage. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of sacrifice synergies and direct damage, ultimately leading to a swift victory.

The main focus of this Mono Black Control deck is to disrupt and control the opponent's resources while utilizing powerful creatures and removal spells to close out the game. The deck includes a variety of hand disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Duress, along with removal spells like Fatal Push and Murderous Rider. The win condition comes from cards like Graveyard Trespasser and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse, allowing the player to dominate the board and outvalue their opponent. The deck also includes card draw spells like Sign in Blood to maintain hand advantage.

This UW Control deck focuses on countering opponent's spells, disrupting their strategy, and controlling the board with removal spells like Supreme Verdict. The deck also includes card advantage engines like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria and Castle Vantress to outvalue the opponent. Shark Typhoon can create threats while also countering spells, and Memory Deluge provides card selection and graveyard recursion. The deck has a mix of land destruction and card draw to maintain control of the game, aiming to win through attrition and outlasting the opponent.

This UW Control deck focuses on maintaining control of the game through board wipes, counterspells, and powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria. The deck also includes cards like Shark Typhoon and Memory Deluge to generate card advantage and pressure the opponent. The inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion allows for extra value by blinking permanents for additional ETB effects. The deck aims to outvalue the opponent and control the game until it can secure a win through card advantage and superior board presence.

This Mono Black Control deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan through a combination of hand disruption, creature removal, and graveyard hate. The key strategy is to use cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push to control the board early on, while also using cards like Sign in Blood and Castle Locthwain for card advantage. Additionally, cards like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Graveyard Trespasser provide additional value by recurring creatures or gaining card advantage from the opponent's graveyard. The deck aims to maintain control of the game until it can secure a win condition with efficient removal spells and powerful threats like Liliana of the Veil and Sorin the Mirthless.

The deck focuses on quickly building a board presence with powerful creatures like Righteous Valkyrie, Skyclave Apparition, and Resplendent Angel, while using Collected Company to dig for key cards. Giada, Font of Hope and Bishop of Wings provide additional support and life gain capabilities. The mana base is optimized for consistency and to support the aggressive strategy of the deck. Overall, the key strategy is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast, aggressive start and maintain pressure throughout the game.

This deck focuses on aggressive gameplay by utilizing powerful creatures and removal spells to quickly overwhelm opponents. The key strategy is to establish a board presence early on with efficient threats like Bonecrusher Giant and Bloodtithe Harvester, while also disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push. The inclusion of cards like Misery's Shadow and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse adds additional pressure and resilience to the deck, allowing it to maintain aggression and close out games swiftly. Additionally, the deck includes a mix of lands to support its aggressive game plan and ensure consistent mana production.

The main concept of this Rakdos Aggro deck is to aggressively disrupt the opponent's hand and board with cards like Thoughtseize and Graveyard Trespasser, while also applying pressure with efficient creatures like Bonecrusher Giant and Bloodtithe Harvester. The deck aims to control the board with removal spells like Dreadbore and Power Word Kill, and finish the game with powerful threats like Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse. The deck also has some land disruption with Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and utility lands like Hive of the Eye Tyrant to maintain tempo and pressure the opponent.

This Selesnya Aggro deck focuses on quickly deploying a board presence of angels and clerics, utilizing cards like Resplendent Angel and Righteous Valkyrie to pump up the team and gain life. Collected Company allows for explosive creature plays, while Portable Hole and Skyclave Apparition offer removal options. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a steady stream of threats while gaining life to outlast aggressive opponents. The mana base is optimized for consistent white and green sources to smoothly curve out the aggressive plays.
